_comments: The credential type a video provider's MJ: Credentials record takes (the meetings plan, § 7), moved here from Committees. Zoom: a Server-to-Server OAuth app's account id, client id and secret. Teams: the tenant id, client id and secret, and the organizer's AAD object id or UPN. Google Meet: the service account's email and private key, and the user it impersonates.

fields.Name: Video Provider OAuth
fields.Description: OAuth credentials for video conferencing providers (Zoom Server-to-Server, Teams, Google Meet)
fields.FieldSchema: {"type": "object", "properties": {"client_id": {"type": "string", "title": "Client ID / Service Account Email"}, "client_secret": {"type": "string", "title": "Client Secret / Private Key PEM"}, "account_id": {"type": "string", "title": "Account ID (Zoom) / Tenant ID (Teams) / Impersonated User (Google)"}, "organizer_user_id": {"type": "string", "title": "Organizer User ID (Teams only) \u2014 AAD Object ID or UPN"}}, "required": ["client_id", "client_secret", "account_id"]}
